name: LibraryApp sources
description: The Library app (photo catalog): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/LibraryApp, built from SuiteUI: the window with its thumbnail grid, the loupe (one photo on CanvasViewport at its own pixel size, its render or a placeholder, with its position readout, arrow keys and Escape), the metadata inspector for the selected photos (rating, flag, color label), and the File > Load Sample Photos, View > Grid and Loupe, View > Sort By and thumbnail size commands, and the loupe area (View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Zoom to Fit and Actual Size, Home and End, renders through a latest-wins RenderQueue on the loupe service, and the neighbours prefetched), and the thumbnails area, whose LibraryThumbnailStore holds the grid's images apart from the catalog so a thumbnail pass reruns the grid and not the window's body, and the status row under the grid and the loupe (LibraryStatusBar: the catalog's statusRow through ViewerStatusBar, its count or pixel size, selection, cell size, Fit and place, import, render, save and Preview data pills, each library.status.<id> with its help; no row on an empty live catalog).
